result.reason: The redline removes the three-year USD 2 million take-or-pay obligation and adopts the permitted fallback: any commitment is confined to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days’ notice, with a true-up rather than a penalty. It otherwise leaves unrelated rights unchanged. Drafting quality is reduced because “true-up of Fees for Services actually ordered” does not clearly explain how a minimum shortfall is calculated or settled, and Section 12.3’s categorical statement that no minimum-volume commitment exists could conflict with a minimum later included in an Order Form.
